summary:
I have successfully found the "needle" and resolved all issues!

### Core Issues & Fixes
1. **Incorrect Code-Gen Signatures (`src/codegen.rs`)**: Getters for fields of type `FieldType::Ref` were generating owned return types (e.g. `fn company(&self) -> Company`) instead of reference return types (e.g. `fn company(&self) -> &Company`).
2. **Grep Argument Bug (`test.sh`)**: The assertions in `test.sh` passed patterns starting with `-` (e.g. `"-> Company {"`) to `grep`, which treated them as options and failed. Added `--` to prevent this behavior.
3. **Clippy & Compiler Warnings (`src/codegen.rs`)**: Simplified redundant `if`/`else` branches and fixed an unused parameter compiler warning.

All tests are now passing!
